// Fixture-only bridge exercises the actual component mutations without a provider.
import { v as fixtureV } from "convex/values";
import * as fixtureHelpers from "../../lib/oauth/dbHelpers.ts";
export const fixtureBridge = mutation({
  args: { stateHash: fixtureV.string(), ticketCodeHash: fixtureV.string() },
  returns: fixtureV.union(fixtureV.null(), fixtureV.number()),
  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
    const claimed = await fixtureHelpers.claimAuthorizationRequest<
      Doc<"authorizationRequests">
    >(ctx, args.stateHash);
    if (!claimed || claimed.expired) return null;
    await fixtureHelpers.insertTicket<Doc<"tickets">>(ctx, {
      stateHash: args.stateHash,
      ticketCodeHash: args.ticketCodeHash,
      encryptedPayload: "fixture",
      authorizationStartedAt: claimed.doc.authorizationStartedAt,
    });
    return claimed.doc.authorizationStartedAt;
  },
});
export const fixtureMint = mutation({
  args: {
    stateHash: fixtureV.string(),
    ticketCodeHash: fixtureV.string(),
    encryptedPayload: fixtureV.string(),
  },
  returns: fixtureV.null(),
  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
    const r = await fixtureHelpers.claimAuthorizationRequest<
      Doc<"authorizationRequests">
    >(ctx, args.stateHash);
    if (!r || r.expired) throw new Error("missing authorization");
    await fixtureHelpers.insertTicket<Doc<"tickets">>(ctx, {
      stateHash: args.stateHash,
      ticketCodeHash: args.ticketCodeHash,
      encryptedPayload: args.encryptedPayload,
      authorizationStartedAt: r.doc.authorizationStartedAt,
    });
    return null;
  },
});
